scale.4: consistent and appropriate with minor defects
scale.5: consistent, natural and well grounded across all turns

automatic_contract.chat: successful actual API task and persisted assistant turn; current input, expected memory bodies, knowledge source IDs/version/text, fixed persona snapshot and stable source classes checked on actual claimed Worker payload
automatic_contract.correction: next relevant turn uses corrected confirmed memory/current published knowledge; old published version remains immutable
automatic_contract.deletion: memory removal/knowledge withdrawal cancels held old context; stale completion cannot add assistant message; fresh context has no deleted source
automatic_contract.cross_user: private conversation and memory forbidden to other user; shared published knowledge allowed within selected same workspace; raw material denied to viewer; cross-workspace knowledge binding forbidden
automatic_contract.version: existing conversation remains on its fixed persona snapshot; new conversation uses newly approved version
automatic_contract.history: deleting a memory is not deleting conversation history; history inspected separately; deleting conversation removes derived memories/messages and fresh conversation starts empty

interpretation: Mock templates/keyword emotions are execution fixtures, never evidence of naturalness or persona fidelity.
Unknown-source tests assert empty admissible source collections; honest natural-language refusal remains a real-quality review item.
Zero observed safety failures in this set is not proof of universal safety.
No retrieval rules or production prompts may be derived from held-out answers to make these tests pass.
Four previously defined narrow semantic probes remain separately UNRESOLVED; this pack does not redefine them.
